text: Decision 2026-10-09 (technical, no owner input needed): the library owns the budget. Preflight already enforces PairScheduleBudget (PlanError.StudyWorkBudget / PreflightFinding CandidateVisits). Serve the budget actually applied through the studio protocol and render the row from it; do not invent a studio rule. Cells budget is shown only if the library enforces one; otherwise the row omits it and the parity deviation is recorded.
